critical.msg: Token extraction regex changed from [^@:]+ to [^@]+ — now captures password colon and everything after it. For URL like https://x-access-token:ghp_xxxx@github.com the captured group becomes 'ghp_xxxx:password' instead of 'ghp_xxxx', breaking GitHub API auth when remote has user:token format.

_Lock.__enter__ dropped atomic os.O_EXCL file creation. New code uses write_text() on an already-checked path — classic TOCTOU race: multiple processes check path.exists() simultaneously, both pass, both write, last-write-wins non-atomically. On heavily loaded CI, two pipeline.py runs could corrupt each other's lock.

Bare except: in create_deploy_issue.py catches Exception plus KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit, masking scripting errors and preventing graceful interrupt. Also silently swallows JSONDecodeError which indicates file exists but is corrupted — different severity than FileNotFoundError.

shared-memory/PROGRESS.md and shared-memory/logs/code-review.log added to repo. These are generated runtime artifacts (production status reports, execution logs) and should not be committed. They belong in the ignore list or remote shared-memory only.

warnings: Bare except: in create_deploy_issue.py (line 40) and pipeline.py Write result envelope blocks — same pattern
_FILENAME_RE regex compiled but never used in pipeline.py
implement removed from _collect_stats agents list but step_implement() still exists
PIPELINE_NO_DOTENV guard removed — _load_dotenv_into_environ now runs on import, could pollute test environment isolation
step_orchestrator docstring simplified but no functional change — minor
suggestions: Restore [^@:]+ in _gh_open_pr token extraction (line 1180) to exclude colon from captured token
Restore os.O_EXCL atomic create in _Lock.__enter__ or use rename-based atomic write to prevent TOCTOU races
Replace bare except: with except (FileNotFoundError, JSONDecodeError): to preserve error distinction
Add shared-memory/PROGRESS.md and shared-memory/logs/ to .gitignore or remove from commit
Consider re-adding PIPELINE_NO_DOTENV guard for testability of pipeline.py
llm_parsed.summary: Four critical-severity issues block merge. 1) Token regex [^@]+ now captures password colon — all GitHub API calls broken when remote uses user:token format. 2) _Lock lost atomic exclusive file creation — concurrent pipeline runs can race and corrupt locks. 3) Bare except: swallows KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit and collapses FileNotFoundError vs JSONDecodeError into silent failure. 4) Generated runtime artifacts (PROGRESS.md, code-review.log) added to repo — should be ignored. Warnings include unused _FILENAME_RE, removed implement from stats collection, removed PIPELINE_NO_DOTENV guard. Recommend reverting regex and _Lock atomicity, fixing except clauses, removing generated files.
